Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of In  praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus, to direct the respondent  and 4 to appoint an arbitrator so as to enhance the compensation award f  petitioner acquired property in project of Dindigul to Pollachi National  Highway No. 209 scheme in the light of the reference under section 3G(5)

For Petitioner : Mr.D.S.Haroon Rasheed  For Respondent : Mr.K.Govindarajan  DSGI for R1
: Mr.S.Ra.Ramachandran

Additional Government Pleader for R2,
 : Mr.P.Karthik for R4  ORDER Heard both sides.
2.
The writ prayer has not been properly worded.

The central government has appointed the jurisdictional District Collector as arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the National Highways Act,
1956.
The petitioner's lands had been acquired.
The compensation fixed by the authority is not acceptable to the petitioner.
The petitioner has already filed a petition before the second respondent.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 3.

The second respondent is directed to dispose of the petition mentioned proceedings bearing Na.Ka.No.965706/2023/I1, dated 2.06.2023 on merits and in accordance with law within a period of six months and pass final award.
4. The Writ Petition is disposed of accordingly.
No costs.
